def move(terrain, start, duration_s, n_runs, seed):
    import numpy as np
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    n_steps = 60
    dt = duration_s / (n_steps - 1)
    points = np.empty((n_runs, n_steps, 3), dtype=float)
    points[:, 0, 0] = start[0]
    points[:, 0, 1] = start[1]
    points[:, 0, 2] = 0.0
    lat = points[:, 0, 0]
    lon = points[:, 0, 1]
    ok = np.ones(n_runs, dtype=bool)
    cell_m = terrain.cell_m
    m_lat = terrain.m_lat
    m_lon = terrain.m_lon
    dist_step = cell_m
    for i in range(1, n_steps):
        # Clamp current positions inside box (if outside, remain there)
        lat, lon = terrain.clamp(lat, lon)
        # Compute local bearings (8 neighbors): NW, N, NE, E, SE, S, SW, W in rad
        nbr_bearing_deg = np.array([315,0,45,90,135,180,225,270])
        nbr_bearing = np.deg2rad(nbr_bearing_deg)
        # For each run, compute neighbors lat/lon
        nbr_lat = np.empty((n_runs, 8), dtype=float)
        nbr_lon = np.empty((n_runs, 8), dtype=float)
        for j in range(8):
            nbr_lat[:,j], nbr_lon[:,j] = terrain.offset(lat, lon, nbr_bearing[j], dist_step)
        # Elevations at neighbors
        nbr_elev = terrain.elev(nbr_lat.ravel(), nbr_lon.ravel()).reshape(n_runs, 8)
        # Current elevation
        elev = terrain.elev(lat, lon)
        d_elev = nbr_elev - elev[:, None]
        # Horizontal distance approx dist_step for all neighbors (8 directions)
        # Compute slope = d_elev / dist_step, but we want steepest descent
        # Mask neighbors outside box to large positive slope to exclude
        inside_nbr = terrain.inside(nbr_lat.ravel(), nbr_lon.ravel()).reshape(n_runs,8)
        slope = np.full((n_runs,8), 1e6)
        slope = np.where(inside_nbr, d_elev / dist_step, 1e6)
        # Steepest descent: minimal slope (most negative)
        # But only consider negative slope directions (descending)
        slope_desc = np.where(slope < 0, slope, np.inf)
        min_idx = np.argmin(slope_desc, axis=1)
        # If no descending neighbor (all inf), stay in place
        no_desc = np.isinf(slope_desc[np.arange(n_runs), min_idx])
        # For runs with descent possible, move to that neighbor
        new_lat = np.where(no_desc, lat, nbr_lat[np.arange(n_runs), min_idx])
        new_lon = np.where(no_desc, lon, nbr_lon[np.arange(n_runs), min_idx])
        # For runs with no descent, try flat (zero slope) neighbors; else stay
        flat_mask = slope == 0
        has_flat = flat_mask.any(axis=1)
        flat_idx = np.argmax(flat_mask, axis=1)
        no_move = no_desc & (~has_flat)
        move_flat = no_desc & has_flat
        new_lat = np.where(move_flat, nbr_lat[np.arange(n_runs), flat_idx], new_lat)
        new_lon = np.where(move_flat, nbr_lon[np.arange(n_runs), flat_idx], new_lon)
        new_lat = np.where(no_move, lat, new_lat)
        new_lon = np.where(no_move, lon, new_lon)
        # Update time elapsed in points
        points[:, i, 2] = points[:, i-1, 2] + dt
        # Distance travelled this step (approx)
        d_horiz = np.hypot((new_lat - lat)*m_lat, (new_lon - lon)*m_lon)
        d_elev_step = terrain.elev(new_lat, new_lon) - elev
        speed = terrain.tobler_speed_ms(d_elev_step, d_horiz)
        max_dist = speed * dt
        # If move distance > max_dist, limit to max_dist along vector
        over_dist = d_horiz > max_dist
        move_dist = np.where(over_dist, max_dist, d_horiz)
        # Unit vectors for moves; avoid div 0
        dx = (new_lat - lat)*m_lat
        dy = (new_lon - lon)*m_lon
        norm = np.where(d_horiz>0, d_horiz, 1)
        ux = dx / norm
        uy = dy / norm
        lat = lat + (ux * move_dist) / m_lat
        lon = lon + (uy * move_dist) / m_lon
        points[:, i, 0] = lat
        points[:, i, 1] = lon
        # Update ok: within terrain box
        ok &= terrain.inside(lat, lon)
    return points, ok
